findings.title: Include the site fallback locale in the translation cache key
findings.body: Fallback results now depend on SiteSetting.default_locale, but the accelerator caches no-options I18n.t calls using only the translation key, requested locale, and backend object ID. For a key missing from a user's selected locale, two sites with different default locales can therefore receive the same cached fallback translation. Changing the default locale can likewise leave that user seeing the old fallback language. The cache must account for the fallback configuration or be appropriately partitioned and invalidated.

findings.title: Load fallback locales for translations outside controller requests
findings.body: This before-filter is the only added call that loads fallback translation files. The translation accelerator itself still loads only I18n.config.locale, while the backend fallback module looks up other locales without loading their files. A background job or mailer translating in one locale can therefore skip an unloaded, non-English site-default locale even when that locale contains the missing key, returning English or a missing-translation result instead. Fallback loading needs to occur in the translation path, not only during HTTP requests.
